name: enhancement
description: A proposed capability or UX improvement

name: dependencies
description: Dependency updates; never an automatic merge approval

name: area:installation
description: Plugin Store, bootstrap, Compose and first-run experience

name: area:compatibility
description: CPA native behavior, credentials and transport compatibility

name: area:quota
description: Read-only quota and reset-credit visibility or bridge behavior

name: area:release
description: Version lifecycle, registry, artifacts and release acceptance

name: area:build
description: CI, toolchains, containers and portable builds

name: status:needs-triage
description: Awaiting scope, reproduction and impact assessment

name: status:confirmed
description: Observed with evidence; not necessarily fixed

name: status:needs-validation
description: Needs current-base checks or runtime acceptance before merge/release

name: status:blocked
description: An explicit dependency or upstream constraint prevents completion

name: help wanted
description: A scoped contribution would be useful

name: good first issue
description: Maintainer-reviewed, small and well-scoped newcomer work

name: release:breaking
description: A user-visible migration or compatibility break

name: release:internal
description: Internal-only work excluded from generated release-note suggestions
